# Requirements Quality Checklist: Admin Management

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurable quality of the admin-management requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-14
**Feature**: [../spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are administrator provisioning, credential rotation/recovery, session expiry, and lockout requirements defined beyond the explicit absence of self-registration? [Gap, Spec §Story 1, §FR-012, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the required fields, uniqueness rules, and validation limits specified for categories, subcategories, and products? [Completeness, Spec §Story 2, §FR-001–006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are list page sizes, sort order, date-filter timezone/range, and behavior for empty search/filter results defined? [Gap, Spec §Story 3, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK004 Are administrator audit/history requirements specified for catalog edits, product archive, and order-status changes? [Gap, Spec §FR-001–020]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the meaning of category/subcategory “delete” clear where active storefront references or historical orders exist? [Clarity, Spec §Story 2, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK006 Are supported order status values, allowed transitions, and behavior for concurrent status updates fully enumerated? [Clarity, Spec §Story 4, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the registered-user and order search fields, matching rules, case/format normalization, and date-filter inclusivity specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK008 Are product archive visibility rules clear for storefront, catalog search, existing carts, and historical order views? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §FR-018–020]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Are admin credential storage/provisioning rules consistent with no self-registration, no forced password change, and customer authentication separation? [Consistency, Spec §Story 1, §FR-014, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Are user-list mobile-only disclosure requirements consistent with the order list's necessary display of fulfillment address and customer details? [Consistency, Spec §Story 3, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK011 Are delete/archive semantics consistent across the CRUD story, dependency rules, and historical order retention? [Consistency, Spec §Story 2, §FR-015]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Are catalog CRUD and dependency-prevention outcomes measurable for all category, subcategory, and product combinations? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003–004]
- [ ] CHK013 Are “within two minutes” and “within one minute” usability criteria defined with participant, data setup, and success boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK014 Are concurrent edits and deletes covered where dependencies can change between the administrator's review and submission? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §Story 2, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK015 Are service failure, retry, stale data, duplicate submission, and uncertain commit recovery requirements specified for every admin mutation? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK016 Are empty, loading, success, validation, and service-error states explicitly mapped to each admin list and catalog/order action? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK017 Are authorization requirements specified for every protected page and operation, including direct API access and session expiration? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK018 Are privacy and minimization requirements explicit for customer mobile data, delivery addresses, order history, and administrative access? [Gap, Spec §Story 3, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK019 Are accessibility requirements detailed for tables/lists, filters, pagination, form errors, dialogs, and status updates? [Coverage, Spec §FR-013]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Ambiguities

- [ ] CHK020 Are ownership and service boundaries defined for Admin Identity, shopper identity, Catalog, Customer, Order, and Cart records without conflicting cross-service data access? [Dependency, Spec §FR-018–020]
- [ ] CHK021 Are order retention, product snapshot requirements, and archival behavior documented sufficiently to preserve historical fulfillment records? [Assumption, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the fixed single-administrator assumption validated, including whether future roles or multiple accounts are explicitly out of scope? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
